text: The accepted addIfRecent comment still says the function maintains only aMaxHits items and pops the oldest. The implementation now pushes every recent item and applies sort and slice afterward. For this helper, rewrite that comment to describe collection and the later limit if the source is changed. This is a proposed comment repair backed by the current implementation; it is not a claim that reviewers accepted a new project-wide comment rule. These conclusions come from static source inspection. No runtime test or accessibility session was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
